title: Why Public-Safety Wages May Grow Differently: A Visual Atlas of Municipal Compensation Evidence
author: Joachim Johnson
subject: Municipal compensation mechanisms, final claim boundaries, project-wide limitations, and research methodology
rights_note: Source-document redistribution remains subject to the source-library review; the atlas contains bounded analytical summaries and source-linked evidence.
accessibility_title: Visual atlas of municipal compensation evidence and its limits
description: A visual-first account of how compensation mechanisms operate in reviewed municipal records, what fourteen adjudicated claims support, and what the evidence does not establish.
